Submit the required information to the following Contracting Officer (CO) and Contract Specialist (CS): Primary Point of Contact (CS): Vida Mata - v ida.mata@us.af.mil Secondary Point of Contact (CO) : Ryan Hopkin - Ryan.hopkin@us.af.mil 2.
